title: Joomla Extension - regularlabs.com - Exposure of Sensitive Information to Unauthorized Actor in Users Anywhere…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla extension Users Anywhere (regularlabs.com) before version 3.0.1 allows an administrator to bypass settings that disable output of user email addresses or usernames. Specifically, attributes inside {user} or [email]/[username] tags can override plugin settings to display personal data despite restrictions. This does not bypass policies that completely disallow Users Anywhere tags in content sources.
